root_cause.aten_layer: torch.cat legacy handling for zero-element tensors bypasses normal dimension validation when all inputs are empty.

bug_oracle.description: Expected RuntimeError for invalid concatenation dimension, but torch.cat silently succeeds with empty input tensors.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate concatenation dim across invalid values while keeping all input tensors empty.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct zero-element tensors, e.g., torch.randn([0]) or torch.empty([0]), to populate the input list.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Use dim values outside the valid range: dim >= tensor.ndim or dim < -tensor.ndim.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Create two or more empty tensors of the same shape, then call torch.cat([tensor1, tensor2], dim=invalid_dim).
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Check API contract by expecting a RuntimeError for invalid dim. If torch.cat returns without raising, flag as a validation bypass.
